name: Tern Station
era_and_technology: A far-future orbital habitat built from scrapped ships bolted together; suits, drones and tethers do the work, and almost nothing is made new.
everyday_life: Air is metered and taxed, so every breath is accounted for, and everyone eats, sleeps and argues within sight of someone who is counting.
history: The station was assembled from wrecks pulled out of the debris field around a dead gas giant after the shipping lanes moved away.

places.name: Dock 9
places.description: The oldest dock, long and cold, lined with salvage racks and the hulks of half-stripped wrecks.
places.effect: People lower their voices and keep their hands where others can see them.

places.name: The Spindle
places.description: The market ring at the station's center, crowded, loud and lit around the clock.
places.effect: Nobody can stay anonymous or alone there; everyone is drawn into trading, gossip and favors.

objects.name: The Lattice
objects.description: An old salvage drone, a cage of struts and grapples with a battered sensor array.
objects.significance: It can reach wrecks no diver can, and it keeps a record of everything it has seen, so whoever controls it controls what is known about the deep.

powers.name: The Salvage Authority
powers.nature: The body that licenses every dive, owns the docks and sets the air tax.
powers.hold: It controls the air supply and the dock leases, so no one can live or work outside its permission.
powers.felt: People pay the air tax every day and plan their work around its inspections and notices.

rules.statement: Divers may not cross the Line, the old debris boundary.
rules.cost: Anyone caught beyond it loses their license and their air allowance.
rules.when_broken: The Authority revokes the license and seals the offender's locker.

rules.statement: The Authority dumps its own waste beyond the Line, which is the real reason the Line is forbidden.
rules.cost: Anyone who proves it threatens the Authority's license to run the station.
rules.when_broken: The waste drifts back toward the habitat and fouls the dock intakes.

terms.meaning: the levy on every breath taken on the station
